en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a divided back. The front shows a large public square with a domed former mosque/church on the left, a tall Baroque plague column in the center, and rows of multi‑story buildings with shops and awnings on the right. Several people stand or walk in the open square, with horse‑drawn vehicles in the background. At the top are printed and handwritten captions. The reverse side contains a handwritten message in cursive, an address written to a person in Sopron, Hungary, a Hungarian postage stamp of 1000 korona, and vertical printed publishing information along the left margin.
